scope: Read-only inventory presentation and journal browsing

cases.scenario: Inspect empty, one-item, six-item and seven-or-more-item views; Previous/Next reach all items and direct rows follow the selected page.
Change or remove a displayed item before selecting its row; selection refreshes AGIS and resolves the instance GUID rather than selecting a different item by index.
Compare occupied-space totals to actual rotated AGIS item footprints. A fragmented destination still rejects a transfer that does not fit without losing the source.
Move one item in each direction, reject stale views, and retry an unresolved transfer; retain the original operation ID and existing save boundary.
Read each discovered journal entry, including the transmission; browsing grants no discovery, acknowledgement, repair or travel action.
Select a new item or journal entry at 720p/1080p with 100-150 percent text; the reader scrolls to the text and keyboard/controller focus remains usable.
Refresh while focused on a command, including a dynamic item row; restore the same enabled command when present and use a valid fallback after removal.
Start/load another campaign and reopen the journal; only that campaign's discoveries appear and old reading state is cleared.
